_comment: Copy to netlink/unit.json (git-ignored) and fill in YOUR unit's values. lan_mac: the MAC on the case label (ELAN_MAC_ADDR in the config partition). wifi_mac: BSSID for the IoT SSID (label MAC + 1 works). wifi_cal: HW_WLAN0_* from your unit's config partition (read with rtk_factory): four arrays of 14 0xNN bytes, plus integers. country: ISO 3166 code for Wi-Fi rules. luci_iot_mac: optional, lets one host on the IoT side open LuCI. iot_controller_ip: optional, the one home-LAN host (e.g. Home Assistant) allowed to reach IoT devices; default the whole 192.168.1.0/24.
